verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims "fast global payments" as part of its business account, so the product does assert an international payments capability. However, the Payments API lists only ACH, domestic wires and checks, and nothing in the pack documents local-currency payouts or fee disclosure. missing for 10: evidence of paying in local/foreign currencies, transparent FX or fee disclosure, international wire support in docs or API, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-lead, I can send international payments in local currencies with transparent fees
